text: おつかれの　ようですわね　ここで　すこし　おやすみに　なりません？

structure.jp: おつかれの　ようですわね
structure.en: you seem to be tired, don't you

structure.jp: おやすみに　なりません？

patterns.name: お〜になる
patterns.span: おやすみに　なりません
patterns.explanation: お plus a verb cut down to the part before ます, then に　なる, is a very respectful way of saying someone does that thing. おやすみに　なりません = 'you won't rest'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.span: おつかれの　ようです
patterns.explanation: ようだ says how something looks to the speaker; after a thing-word it needs の. おつかれの　ようです = 'you seem tired'.

patterns.name: 〜ませんか
patterns.explanation: A polite 'not' form asked as a question is a gentle invitation; the か is dropped here and the voice rises. おやすみに　なりません？ = 'won't you rest?'.
